arguments.prompt: Create a NEW original pixel-art correction atlas of Professor Azimuth in Woodruff and the Schnibble of Azimuth (1994). Exact appearance: Elderly eccentric Professor Azimuth with white hair, prominent nose, round spectacles and practical pale laboratory coat over dark trousers; small laboratory control apparatus.. The attached prior atlas is for costume and style only. EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS and 1 ROWS = 4 complete new full-body figures. Every row is a different four-pose nonoffensive support action: prepare, consider, decisive helpful gesture in THIRD pose, recover. Show Azimuth’s complete scientist body and a small practical laboratory controller close to his body. Keep the controller and hands clearly separated from neighbouring figures; no loose cable or effect joins cells. Helpful calibration gestures only, no weapon, ray or growth-reversal attack. All head, arms, legs and equipment fit comfortably within each cell with48pixel transparent gutters and32pixel outer margin. FacingRIGHT, detailed16bit pixel art, transparent background. No copied, shifted, mirrored or recoloured duplicate poses. No text, labels, grid, scenery, ground, shadow, victim, injury, blood or harm.
